goal: 复核当前设计指纹下 IFU instruction page fault 与 instruction access fault 的 PC cause tval owner 从 packet first failing halfword 经 FIFO lane capture pending drain 到 CSR request 的证据闭环，判断 IFU-TVAL-G1 是否存在可执行覆盖洞或假绿。

supplied_material: IFU-TVAL-G1 closure requirement is current-design evidence for first failing halfword offsets F2 F4 F6, compressed-control lifecycle, and compile-success RTL source variants.
Current design_id is sha256:6236b176da0c10bccac9c2feb405a0d65ba586d826616f0beaeee0cbbfe2f3dc; production RTL hashes before and after all nine variants are identical.

Canonical command make -C npc/rv64 check-ifu-tval passed eight focused testbenches, module aggregate 109 of 109, ten evidence-tool unit tests, and nine of nine compile-success RTL variants were dynamically rejected.
Packet rule is fault_tval equals packet_pc plus first failing halfword byte offset F; instruction xEPC is selected independently from lane0 or lane1 decoded PC.
FIFO stores fault_tval atomically with packet metadata and focused rows cover F2 F4 F6; decoder focused rows cover F0 F2 F4 F6.
Lifecycle matrix has 24 drain rows: PF 12 AF 12, lane0 12 lane1 12, F0 8 F2 8 F4 6 F6 2; each row checks capture pending and drain.

Compressed c.beqz matrix has six F4 rows: terminal PF and AF produce xEPC PC+2 and tval PC+4; actual-taken branch resolution clears PF and AF pending tuples; predicted-taken lane visibility suppresses PF and AF lane1 owners.
Page-end integration matrix has nine PF rows with F2 count 5, F4 count 3, and F6 count 1.

Pending sequencer focused checks cover capture, hold while valid clears, branch-resolution squash clear, and late clear; CSR mux checks pending owner, independent ex_pc and ex_tval, and zero tval for system events.

Ledger owner paths are OooFetchPacketDecode, OooFetchPacketFifo, OooFrontend, OooFetchHeadPairGate, OooFrontendDispatchGate, OooPendingLane1CaptureGate, OooPendingDispatchArbiter, OooPendingTrapExitSequencer, OooStopPendingSequencer, and OooCsrTrapRequestMux.

Nine source variants cover decoder offset removal, FIFO direct-head PC substitution, FIFO ring PC substitution, lane0 capture PC substitution, lane1 capture PC substitution, pending capture PC substitution, pending squash stale tval retention, CSR request PC substitution, and predicted-taken lane1 visibility removal.

No compile-success source variant directly changes OooFrontend projection, OooFrontendDispatchGate transfer, or OooStopPendingSequencer; their behavior is exercised only through focused and aggregate tests plus current source binding.
Evidence JSON claims IFU-TVAL-G1 CLOSED_ELIGIBLE only, PPA UNQUALIFIED, and promotion_eligible false.
After directed architecture evidence replay and ledger hash refresh, arch-stable audit is honest GAP with 37 remaining blockers and all closed-evidence hashes match current artifacts.

deliverables: 给出 PASS GAP 或 INCONCLUSIVE，逐项列出证据支持、可执行反例、覆盖洞、替代假设、范围扩展请求和 confidence_and_basis；任何可操作反例必须指向应新增的定向 testbench、compile-success RTL variant 或 fail-closed 静态审计。
success_criteria: 结论严格限定于随附材料；区分 IFU-TVAL-G1 架构关闭资格与完整核及 PPA 推广资格；不能用模块 aggregate 代替字段级 oracle；若发现 owner path 未被直接负向变体约束，说明其是否足以阻止关闭以及最小补证。
